leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Apply the @scope rule to isolate CSS styles within a specific DOM subtree.
Construct a scoped style block that targets elements only within a defined root boundary.
Configure the @scope rule with both a root selector and a scoping limit to control style inheritance.
Manipulate CSS specificity by using @scope to override global styles without increasing selector weight.
Integrate @scope with existing CSS to create modular, maintainable component styles.
Implement scoped styles that prevent CSS rules from leaking out of their intended container.
Update a stylesheet by replacing nested selectors with @scope for clearer style encapsulation.
